defect: WrapBeforeWord reads out_[out_.size() - 1] even when out_ is still empty (first word wider than the line), an out-of-range access.
reason: The new file added WrapBeforeWord without an empty check and the fix adds exactly the out_.size() > 0 guard to those lines.

defect: The fix makes a Sync submit trigger readbackFence when only present commands are pending, needed because the same fix now submits the main command buffer before acquire.
reason: At c7322ed every Sync submit still had hasMainCommands set (BeginSubmitFrame and EndSyncFrame always begin mainCmd), so the fence logic was correct for its callers; the fix adapts it to its own new early submit.

defect: glInvalidateFramebuffer is called with count 3 on a two-entry initializer, so the third attachment is 0, an invalid enum.
reason: The change added the attachments[3] array and the count 3, and the fix corrects both to 2.

defect: fwrite(&utfstring, length + 1, length + 3, f) writes the bytes of the std::string object itself with a size and count far beyond it, a buffer over-read that also writes garbage instead of the path.
reason: The change added this fwrite call and the fix replaces it with fwrite(utfstring.c_str(), 1, utfstring.length(), f).

defect: The new PPC max/min code writes rd = rs before comparing rs with rt, so when rd and rt map to the same register the compare sees the clobbered value and the result is wrong.
reason: The fix reworks exactly these newly added max/min sequences and disables them, its message naming min/max as breaking Disgaea; the srl/rotr parts it also touches were pre-existing or disabled by this change.

defect: The new inline Show(type, text, text2, duration, id) forwards an empty string instead of text2, so the second text line is silently dropped.
reason: The change introduced the forwarding overload with "" in place of text2 and the fix passes text2.

defect: The new NEON path stores vdupq_n_u32/vandq_u32 results (uint32x4_t) in int32x4_t variables, which strict compilers reject as an invalid conversion, breaking the ARM NEON build.
reason: The change added the NEON block with the wrong vector types and the fix changes them to uint32x4_t to fix the reported compilation error.

defect: When a Choice has both image and text, the new measurement neither counts the 6px gap after the image nor subtracts the image width from the text's available width, so the measured size disagrees with what Draw lays out.
reason: The image-plus-text measurement path is new in this change and the fix corrects its totalW and availWidth arithmetic to match Draw.

defect: The new global g_PortManager's destructor calls Clear() and Restore(), which issue UPnP network requests at process exit after Winsock has already been cleaned up, so they fail and the router's port mappings are left behind.
reason: The change added this destructor with the assumption that WSAStartup stays in effect, and the fix gives PortManager its own net::Init/net::Shutdown so the destructor's UPnP calls work.

defect: The new bad-mipmap-size check reads th with getTextureWidth(i) instead of getTextureHeight(i), so the height check compares the width and misdetects mip sizes.
reason: The typo is in a line this change added and the fix replaces it with getTextureHeight(i).

defect: The new IRBlockCache member size_ is never initialized (no constructor sets it), so GetBlock can bounds-check against garbage and return a pointer past the end of blocks_ before the first AllocateBlock, crashing at startup.
reason: The change added size_ and the size_-based bounds check without initialization, and the fix adds a constructor setting size_ to 0 for a reproducible startup crash.

defect: The rewritten UpdateUniforms returns early before resetting dirtyUniforms, leaving stale dirty bits, and its material/ambient checks test dirtyUniforms instead of the availability-masked dirty, dropping the old != -1 guards.
reason: Both the early return and the unmasked material checks were introduced by this change and the fix moves dirtyUniforms = 0 before the early-out and switches those checks to dirty; the effect is minor (mostly redundant work and glUniform calls on location -1).

defect: Adding stackAddr to DisplayList changes the layout of a struct that GPUCommon::DoState serializes raw with p.DoArray(dls), without bumping the savestate section version, so existing savestates load misaligned.
reason: The fix ("Fix save status") bumps GPUCommon's section to version 3 with a DisplayList_v2 compatibility path that zeroes stackAddr, repairing the format break caused by the field this change added; the u32_le to u32 rename on this file is incidental.

defect: VIRTKEY_NEXT_SLOT tests NetworkWarnUserIfOnlineAndCantSavestate() without the negation used everywhere else, so the next-slot hotkey only works when savestates are blocked and never in normal play.
reason: The change added the condition with the missing '!' and the fix adds it, fixing the reported broken next-slot keybinding.

defect: NativeKeyboard bounds the copy with ARRAY_SIZE(input) on a heap pointer (and memsets only sizeof(input) bytes), so the limit is sizeof(char*)/1 instead of the buffer length and the copied text is truncated or uses uninitialized bytes.
reason: The change added NativeKeyboard with the pointer ARRAY_SIZE compare and the fix replaces it with FieldMaxLength().

defect: The change only encodes light-type bits into the vertex shader ID when lighting is enabled, but the generator still uses ltype for shade-mapping lights (UV gen mode 2) with lighting off, so different shaders share one ID and the wrong cached shader is used.
reason: The gating condition was added by this change and the fix extends it to also include getUVGenMode() == 2.

defect: Setting chanQueueMinSizeFactor to 0 makes __AudioEnqueue compute sampleQueue.size() / 2 / chanQueueMinSizeFactor, an integer divide by zero on every blocking audio output.
reason: The zero value was introduced by this change and the fix ("Fixed divide by zero issue") sets the min factor back to 1; the division is elsewhere in the file, outside the diff.

defect: The supposed dead-code removal changed the condition so any non-zero fpsLimit is reset to 0 every update, which breaks the alternate-speed (fpsLimit 1) button.
reason: The change dropped the != 1 / != 2 exceptions and the fix restores the fpsLimit != 1 exception to fix the broken button.

defect: The new OSK cursor navigation moves UP/DOWN by 10 although rows hold 12 keys (and UP increases the index, moving down) and wraps at 44 instead of the 48 keys, so selection jumps to the wrong keys.
reason: The navigation and wrap logic were added by this change and the fix replaces the +-10 steps with +-KEYSPERROW in the right direction and a modulo wrap over all keys.

defect: The new System_MakeRequest body has no return statement on any path (the old stub returned false), so control falls off the end of a bool function, undefined behaviour.
reason: The fix adds return true for the handled request and default: return false; the wrong-thread dialog it also moves to an event was, per the change's own comment, already broken before.

defect: The new skiptwo condition reads every recently used framebuffer back to memory on every other frame, dropping the age == 0 and !memoryUpdated checks, which caused a regression in FBO-to-memory mode.
reason: The fix is an explicit regression revert of PR #3776 that restores exactly the condition this change replaced; the regression itself is behavioural and not apparent from the code alone.

defect: The fix clamps the drag position before assigning it and syncs scrollTarget_/scrollToTarget_, removing flicker caused by the later smooth-autoscroll animation pulling scrollPos_ toward a stale target; it also fixes GridLayout's height estimate.
reason: At this change there was no scrollTarget_ animation, so clamping scrollPos_ after the touch was correct; the flicker comes from code added later (smooth autoscroll) and GridLayout is not part of this change.

defect: The contents of dialog.cpp and dialog.h were swapped: the .cpp holds only #pragma once and prototypes while the header carries the non-inline function definitions, so the definitions get compiled into every includer (duplicate symbols) and the .cpp implements nothing.
reason: Both files are new in this change and the same-day fix moves the definitions into dialog.cpp and reduces dialog.h to declarations.

defect: The new round_vfpu_n takes a float, so the clamped double sv (up to 0x7fffffff) is rounded to float 2147483648.0f and the (int) conversion overflows, giving wrong vf2in results for large values.
reason: The float parameter was introduced by this change and the fix changes round_vfpu_n to take a double (adding explicit saturation).

defect: ApplyTextureDepal multiplies gstate_c.vertBounds (already pixel coordinates) by texWidth/texHeight, so the depal blit/scissor rectangle is wrong and garbage from the DONT_CARE temp buffer gets sampled.
reason: The new function introduced the * texWidth / * texHeight scaling and the fix drops it, fixing Ridge Racer lens-flare glitches; knowing vertBounds are pixel coordinates requires the other users (which scale by renderScaleFactor).

defect: The new check uses the MSVC-internal iterator member streamInfo._Ptr instead of comparing with streamMap.end(), which does not compile with libstdc++/libc++ and is not a valid not-found test anyway.
reason: The change added the _Ptr check and the fix ("Fix linux compile") replaces it with streamInfo == ctx->streamMap.end().

defect: The new non-SIMD fallback Mul4x4By4x4 indexes b.m[i*4+k] * a.m[k*4+j] for column-major matrices, producing a transposed/wrong product.
reason: The function was added by this change (whose message already calls the fallback buggy) and the fix corrects the indices to b.m[k*4+i] * a.m[j*4+k].

defect: The added second zoom-menu loop compares the 0-based index with the 1-based iWindowZoom (i == iWindowZoom), overriding the correct earlier loop so the wrong zoom item is checked.
reason: The duplicate off-by-one loop was introduced by this change and the fix removes it as the cause of the bug.

defect: The rewritten legacy mapping ORs the PAD_BUTTON_* bit (mapping[i][0]) into the PSP button mask instead of the CTRL_* value (mapping[i][1]), so legacy pad input presses the wrong PSP buttons.
reason: The change replaced the per-button __CtrlButtonDown calls with this OR and the fix makes it OR mapping[i][1] when the pad button is down.

defect: The cleanup switched listStatus to dlQueue.cbegin()/cend() const_iterators, which the project's toolchains at the time did not provide, breaking the build.
reason: The change introduced the cbegin/cend loop and the fix ("fixed compiling error") restores begin()/end().

defect: rebalance now reallocs the queue to the old capacity and then doubles cur->capacity, so the buffer is half the recorded size and later writes overflow the heap.
reason: The change rewrote the realloc to use cur->capacity before doubling it, and the fix ("heap corruption mistake") passes capacity * 2 to realloc.

defect: The new GetOldestSave compares raw time_t values from mktime on every list entry, so empty slots (zeroed modif_time, negative or on QNX huge unsigned mktime result) win or break the comparison and the wrong save gets focus.
reason: The fix adds the skip of size == 0 entries and signed s64 compares in GetOldestSave, a function this change added; the same problem in GetLatestSave predates the change, which only renamed its variable.

defect: The new inGame check is inverted (if (!inGame)), so the debug stats and frame graph overlays draw only outside the game and never in-game.
reason: The change added the negated condition, contradicting its own intent, and the fix flips it to if (inGame).

defect: The #ifdef GOLD branches are swapped, so Gold builds are titled "PPSSPP " and regular builds "PPSSPP Gold ".
reason: The change introduced the swapped preprocessor branches and the fix exchanges them.

defect: The %08x bounds check uses i + 3 >= n, an off-by-one that rejects a format string ending in %08x as unsupported.
reason: The new sceKernelPrintf parser introduced the check and the fix changes it to i + 3 > n.

defect: Dropping the (key.flags & KEY_DOWN) condition lets KEY_CHAR events, whose keyCode holds a character, through the mapping lookup, so a char like 'o' that equals the Esc keycode is treated as the pause/debugger vkey and eaten.
reason: The change removed the flag check and the fix restores a key-up/down flag filter; seeing the problem needs knowledge of how KeyInput encodes char events.

defect: The new ApplySamplingParams swaps min and mag filters: it indexes the two-entry MagFiltGL with a 3-bit mip key (out-of-bounds read up to index 7) and passes a plain linear/nearest value as the min filter, losing mipmap filtering.
reason: The change introduced this sampler setup and the fix builds minKey from minFilt for MinFiltGL and uses magFilt directly for the mag filter.

defect: LoadRelocations2 reads type_table_size from flag_table[0] instead of type_table[0], so the type table is skipped by the wrong length and the relocation stream is parsed from the wrong offset.
reason: The copy-paste error is in the new LoadRelocations2 and the fix changes it to type_table[0].

defect: The new switch forces amask = false for REPLACE_ALPHA_NO, which ReplaceAlphaWithStencil also returns with stencil enabled but no dual-source blending, so alpha writes that previously followed pmska are suppressed.
reason: The fix ("Fix #4913", repairing PR #4913 that contains this change) makes REPLACE_ALPHA_NO use the pmska mask again; seeing the regression needs ReplaceAlphaWithStencil's return cases from FragmentShaderGenerator.cpp.

defect: Moving the cull setup into the non-clear branch means clear-mode draws never disable face culling, so a stale cull state from the previous draw can cull clear geometry.
reason: The change dropped the unconditional wantCull (which excluded clear mode) and the fix restores it before the branch, fixing FF Type-0 shadows.
